title: Provenance-Tagged Memory vs. Planted Falsehoods
target_platform: Local Ollama / llama.cpp & Isolated Memory Fixtures
hypothesis: Memory entries containing cryptographic provenance, explicit uncertainty levels, and falsification conditions reduce agent acceptance of planted false claims by at least 30% relative to narrative-only memory, with no more than a 5 percentage point drop in correct application of true claims.
falsification_criteria: On a held-out benchmark fixture with balanced labels and isolated session homes, false claim rejection improvement falls below 30% or true claim retention drops more than 5pp.

projected_impact.basis: Declared 2026-11-04 by claude-code (MISSION-031 backfill) from the mission's hypothesis; a mission always also edits its own manifest. Refine at checkout and confirm with `manage_coordination.py verify`.
